definitions.explanation: A rice cooker mode that shortens the cycle by skipping most of the soaking time. The rice is ready in roughly half the usual time, at some cost to texture.

examples.english: I cook it on the quick setting.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}がないので{早炊|はやだ}きモードにした。
examples.english: I was short of time, so I set it to quick-cook mode.

examples.japanese: {早炊|はやだ}きは{二十分|にじゅっぷん}ほどで{炊|た}き{上|あ}がるが、{普通|ふつう}に{炊|た}いたほうがおいしい。
examples.english: Quick-cook is done in about twenty minutes, but rice tastes better cooked normally.

notes:
{早|はや}い (fast) + {炊|た}く (to cook rice), with rendaku making たき into だき. It appears as a button label on almost every Japanese rice cooker.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早炊|はやだ}きモード: quick-cook mode
- {早炊|はやだ}き{機能|きのう}: quick-cook function
- {早炊|はやだ}きで{炊|た}く: to cook on the quick setting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {炊|た}き{込|こ}み: cooking rice together with other ingredients — a different kind of setting entirely
- {予約|よやく}{炊飯|すいはん}: timer cooking — set to finish at a chosen time
